# Troubleshooting ownership

Decode owns HND/packed/scale/GQA/window and scratch-bound errors. Prefill owns shallow-support versus tensor binding, packed coordinates, ranges/chunk precedence, mask extents/strides and workspace exclusions. Qualification owns actual-model preparation omissions, process-wide cold/warm cache identity, embedded-library failure, exact native test counts and compile-versus-execution. Root owns missing toolchain/dependency/license and broad excluded scope. Every route has symptom/first-check/recovery-or-stop coverage.
